entries.226482a6e9d11228: RIKEN VITAMIN CO., LTD. manufactures and sells foods such as wakame seaweed products and dressings, as well as improvers for food and chemical products, and vitamins.
entries.6a64375e4d19ceeb: A business that manufactures and sells household foods (such as seaweed (wakame) products, dressings and dashi stock), business-use foods (such as processed foods for the business market), and raw materials for processed foods (such as processed-food raw materials, food modifiers and vitamins for the food industry). It is the largest segment in the group. Seaweed (wakame) products are manufactured by Riken Shokuhin Co., Ltd. and sold by the company. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥66,360 million.
entries.6dbce556496005c6: A segment that manufactures and sells food modifiers, chemical product modifiers, extracts and seasonings. Production subsidiaries in Malaysia and China manufacture modifiers, and sales subsidiaries in Singapore, Vietnam, Thailand, Europe, the United States, China (Shanghai) and Taiwan sell them in each region. GUYMON EXTRACTS INC. in the United States manufactures extracts and seasonings. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥21,252 million.

entries.ccd6cbf6328c269a: A segment that manufactures and sells chemical product modifiers and feed additives. Chemical product modifiers are manufactured by the company and Kenseido Co., Ltd. and sold by the company and Eiken Shoji Co., Ltd. Eiken Shoji Co., Ltd. purchases and sells feed additives. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥8,686 million.

entries.fd60b135074d9d4b: The group consists of the company (RIKEN VITAMIN CO., LTD.) and 18 subsidiaries. Based on the effective use of natural products, which forms the core of its business development, it has three reportable segments: Domestic Food Business, Domestic Chemical Products and Other Business, and Overseas Business. Its head office is located in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo. Consolidated employees number 1,887 (as of March 31, 2026). Consolidated revenue in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥96,300 million.
